label: Self-report research prescreening items (development placeholder)

items.text: I prefer familiar routines over unexpected changes.
I feel comfortable starting conversations with people I do not know well.
I notice small patterns or details in everyday objects.
I find it easy to keep a casual chat going with several people at once.
Bright lights or loud background noise can make it hard for me to focus.
I like switching between tasks without much planning ahead.
Spending time alone feels more restful to me than large social gatherings.
I usually pick up jokes and indirect remarks without needing extra explanation.
I enjoy organizing information into clear categories or lists.
I can ignore background sounds when I am working on something important.
